focus: The site's own release checks were rejecting good releases because one of them only understood how a single web browser words a particular security notice — that is fixed and now verified across all three browsers the studio tests in. The AI news desk also stopped being able to mistake an advertisement for a reported fact, and now records which model wrote each edition instead of assuming.
nextStep: Finish the browser-security migration so the strictest setting can be switched on safely, then the rendered-pixel review of the newly-served pages. Account verification remains on its separate approval path.
